beats.say: He ran a billion dollar black market.
The FBI couldn't find him.
Then a tax agent found him... in one weekend. Using Google.

beats.say: Twenty thirteen. Silk Road. The dark web's biggest drug market.
beats.cap: 2013. Silk Road. The dark web's biggest drug market.

beats.say: Its boss is a ghost called Dread Pirate Roberts.
Hidden behind Tor. Paid in Bitcoin. No name. No face.
I R S agent Gary Alford tries something nobody bothered with.
beats.cap: IRS agent Gary Alford tries something nobody bothered with.

beats.say: He searches for the oldest mention of Silk Road on the internet.
He finds a user called altoid,
posting about the site before almost anyone knew it existed.
Alford reads everything altoid ever wrote.
And in one old post, altoid left an email address.
Ross Ulbrikt, at gmail dot com.
His real name.
October first, twenty thirteen. A library in San Francisco.
beats.cap: October 1, 2013. A library in San Francisco.

beats.say: Two agents start a fake lovers' fight. Ross turns to look.
They grab his laptop... still logged in.
beats.cap: They grab his laptop. Still logged in.

beats.say: Sentenced to life.
Pardoned in twenty twenty five.
The perfect hidden empire. Undone by one email he typed two years earlier.
